lines.en: I have no legs; I travel by rolling.

lines.zh: 我一下一下地弹，往远处去。
lines.en: I bounce, once at a time, getting further away.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬住地面，把自己拖过去。
lines.en: My teeth bite the ground and drag me.
I roll on my side, avoiding the cracks.
I roll faster, afraid of being caught.
I hit the wall and bounce back.
I roll toward the dark. It is safer there.

lines.zh: 我沿台阶一级一级往下跳。
lines.en: I hop down the steps one at a time.
My hair is caught in the mail ring.

lines.zh: 我滚过的地上留着灰痕。
lines.en: A trail of ash follows my roll.

lines.zh: 我不敢停，停下来就会长。
lines.en: I dare not stop; if I stop, I will grow.
I push along with my jaw.

lines.zh: 我停在地上，咬合了一下。
lines.en: I rest on the floor and bite once.
I am slowly growing back.
Something moves below my neck.
My teeth never stop.

lines.zh: 石板一响，我就知道有人。
lines.en: One tap on stone and I know someone is here.
If there is light, I avoid it.

lines.zh: 我在等颈口长出第一根骨。
lines.en: I wait for the first bone at my neck stump.

lines.zh: 我记得自己原来有身体。
lines.en: I remember having a body.

lines.zh: 牙齿一张一合，磨着石屑。
lines.en: My teeth grind open and shut on grit.
Ash falls from my neck opening.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就麻烦了。
lines.en: You have seen me. That is a problem.
I snap my teeth. A warning.

lines.zh: 我没有身体，但我还会咬。
lines.en: I have no body, but I still bite.
You stand between me and the dark.
I am going that way. Move.
You lift your foot; I roll away at once.
I turn to a new direction on the floor.
You cannot keep up with something that rolls.
Do not stomp; it will not crush me.
I will grow back. Wait and see.
The blow knocked me off course.
A tooth chips loose; I swallow it.
I spin twice on the floor.
No body means no pain.
A crack in the bone.
My hair has been trampled.
I will still grow back.
That slowed me a little.
I clench my teeth out of habit.
You cannot shatter me.

lines.zh: 下面的东西早没了，吃不下。
lines.en: Everything below is gone; I cannot eat.

lines.zh: 你把食物举给一颗头看。
lines.en: You show food to a severed head.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我咬都懒得咬。
lines.en: I will not even bother biting that.

lines.zh: 一颗头要的不是这些碎渣。
lines.en: A head has no use for these crumbs.

lines.zh: 你举着它，手就空不出来。
lines.en: Holding it leaves your hands busy.

lines.zh: 没有鼻子，我闻不出香臭。
lines.en: No nose; I cannot tell sweet from foul.
Put it away; I am leaving.
That is in your way, not mine.
I cannot bite it, and do not want to.
Do not try to lure me with that.

lines.zh: 你踢了我一脚，我飞出去。
lines.en: You kicked me; I flew.
I hit the wall and bounced back.
My teeth clacked loudly.
I have no body to retreat with.
You pin me down, and I still move.
That loosened my hair.
I roll behind your feet.
Not your boot. Too filthy.
I hit a step and flipped over.
Kick again and I bite your boot.
I do not even have a neck.
You say this to a head?
I only want my body back.
There are no other heads in this tomb.

lines.zh: 一颗头，听不懂你们的事。
lines.en: I am a head; your business means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我记得有人喊过我的名字。
lines.en: I remember someone calling my name.
That voice is gone now.
I only want to roll further away.
This is a poor time to ask.
Move; I am going into the dark.
I bite a scrap of cloth and drag it.
Too heavy; I cannot push it.
I lift it with my teeth.

lines.zh: 东西卡在牙缝，我甩不掉。
lines.en: It is stuck between my teeth; I cannot shake it.
An old nail — I keep it.
I bit it. Stone.
I nudge it into the corner.
It rolled away; I cannot catch it.
This smells of rust.
I pin it under my teeth.
Footsteps are coming closer.
I open my jaw.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我能咬到脚踝。
lines.en: From here I can reach an ankle.
I lie in a crack and wait.
I hear a living heartbeat.
It is one step away.
I snap once to test my teeth.

lines.zh: 我不能追太远，但没有关系。
lines.en: I cannot chase far, but that is fine.
My eye sockets stay on it.
It watches ahead and never looks down.
The neck stump tenses.
I wait for it to come closer.
I roll into its path.
It is lifting its foot.
I move now.
This bite must land true.
It leaves the back of its neck to me.
I roll along with its feet.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就跟着偏过去。
lines.en: It turns, and my roll shifts with it.
My teeth stay clenched.
It missed a step. Good.

lines.zh: 它回头看，我停在原地装死。
lines.en: It looks back; I stop and play dead.
When it moves, I follow.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根滚到它身后。
lines.en: I roll along the wall to its back.

lines.zh: 它绕着火把走，我不靠近。
lines.en: It keeps to the torch; I keep away.
When it bends, my teeth can reach.
Its ankle is right there.
I approach slowly, silently.
Its bootlace is loose.
I count where its feet land.
No hurry; it must stop eventually.

lines.zh: 它靠墙站着，我贴着墙根。
lines.en: It leans on the wall; I hug the wall base.
Half a foot from it now.
It is bending down.
This is the moment.
I open my mouth, all teeth showing.
Did it hear my teeth?

lines.zh: 牙一合，咬进脚踝的筋里。
lines.en: My teeth close into the tendon at its ankle.
This bite sinks every tooth.

lines.zh: 我挂在它腿上，被拖着走。
lines.en: I hang from its leg and am dragged.
It shakes its leg; I do not let go.
I go for the tendon.
One kick sends me flying.
I land and roll back in.
That will slow it.
My teeth are crueller than a blade.
It cried out. A fine sound.
I am stamped into the dirt, still biting.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，我的牙还带着东西。
lines.en: It tore free; my teeth bring something with them.
I bite again.

lines.zh: 这一口是为了我的身体。
lines.en: This bite is for my body.
It backed two steps; I cannot follow.
It is still standing. Then again.
I open my eye sockets on the floor.
My body is somewhere else.
Ash still rises from my neck.
I try one roll.
The stone scrapes my teeth.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己怎么被砍下来的。
lines.en: I do not know how I was cut down.
But I remember I must grow back.
The floor is cold. Fitting.
I hear movement in the tomb.
I roll toward the dark.
My hair spills across the floor.
Someone will come looking for my body.
I roll into a coffin crack, out of sight.

lines.zh: 我咬合了一下，确认牙还在。
lines.en: I snap once to check my teeth are there.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的头发全卷了。
lines.en: Fire curls all my hair.

lines.zh: 我滚下台阶，牙磕掉了一颗。
lines.en: I roll down the steps and lose a tooth.
Water pours into my neck and I sink.
The blast slams me into a niche.
An arrow passes through my eye socket.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进骨头，我的牙在响。
lines.en: A curse enters the bone and my teeth chatter.
I am not hungry, but I am drying out.

lines.zh: 雷打在地上，我整颗头都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the floor and my whole skull lights.
The floor is gone; I keep falling.
